description: This file defines the route handlers for the Express server related to the Tic-Tac-Toe application's API endpoints and static UI serving. It includes routes for serving the main UI, health checks, API documentation, and game-specific actions such as creating games, retrieving game state, and making moves.

methods.name: GET '/'
methods.description: Serves the static index.html file for the Tic-Tac-Toe UI.

methods.name: GET '/health'
methods.description: Returns a JSON object indicating the server's health status and port.

methods.name: GET '/docs'
methods.description: Redirects to the root UI page, used by preview environments probing /docs.

methods.name: GET '/openapi.json'
methods.description: Serves a minimal OpenAPI schema describing the available API endpoints.
